critical_steps: Every image weave in the nonclosed-range example is an orthonormal basis.
The original energy-to-norm-squared ratio at e_N/N is N^2.
With closed range and P onto R(K*), the coefficient energies of Pf_i and f_i agree on R(K*).
A bounded Moore–Penrose preimage yields the reverse upper bound.
R(K*) membership of unprojected vectors is a logically separate requirement.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact diagonal Hilbert-space counterexample; orthogonal projection onto closed R(K*) and bounded Moore–Penrose preimage for the repaired equivalence.
integrity.unproved_limits: Closed range is sufficient, not claimed necessary for particular pairs; alternative range norms not considered.

scientific_limitations: The counterexample refutes the unrestricted printed range-image characterization.
The repaired literal Hilbert-frame statement uses projected families, or original families assumed in R(K*).
The degenerate K=0 case uses arbitrary positive bounds, rather than a zero upper constant.
No historical erratum priority claim is made.
title: A nonclosed-range counterexample and projected closed-range repair for woven \(K\)-frames
